description: This Java class 'BsonUtil' provides utility methods for handling BSON objects, including conversions to BsonDocument, extracting values by key or path, and pretty-printing BSON objects. It is part of the MongoDB persistence utilities within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: BsonUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for BSON object conversions, value extraction, and pretty-printing within MongoDB persistence context.

methods.name: toBsonDocument
methods.description: Converts a Bson object to a BsonDocument, throws NullPointerException if input is null.

methods.name: toBsonDocumentOrNull
methods.description: Converts a Bson object to a BsonDocument or returns null if input is null.

methods.name: toBsonDocuments
methods.description: Converts a collection of Bson objects to a list of BsonDocuments.

methods.name: getRequiredDocumentValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a Document by key, throws if key is missing.

methods.name: getDocumentWithDefaultAt
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a Document by key or returns a default value.

methods.name: getValueByPath
methods.description: Extracts a nested value from a Bson object using a dot-separated path.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a collection of Bson objects.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a single Bson object.
